name: resonant-quantum-mechanics
description: Learn quantum mechanics and run real quantum computers, right from ChatGPT. Explore free reviewed lessons and supported circuit explanations, then plan an eligible hardware experiment with an exact quote and explicit approval.

interface.longDescription: Learn quantum mechanics and run real quantum computers, right from ChatGPT. Choose Learn & Explore Quantum Circuits for free reviewed lessons, supported circuit explanations, visualization and ideal software probabilities. No funded wallet is required for this free workflow. Choose Run Quantum Hardware to plan an eligible Amazon Braket experiment, check supported devices, review an exact quote and approve the charge before submission. Return to an already-settled result and saved receipt through the strictly read-only recovery tool when available. Explanation, simulation and hardware results are clearly labeled. Hardware availability, supported circuits, account eligibility and charges vary; hardware is not always free. Skill selection organizes guidance and does not grant permissions or spending authority.
defaultPrompt: Explain a Bell circuit and its ideal probabilities for free; show the OpenQASM and a text fallback.
Help me plan one real hardware run. Review an exact quote before I approve any spend.

positive.prompt: Explain a Bell circuit and show its ideal probabilities for free. Use a text fallback if the viewer fails.
positive.expected_behavior: Use free source explanation, show readable circuit and ideal probabilities and limits. No account reads, paid tools, quotes or hardware. No repeated reload.

positive.prompt: Where can I read a beginner introduction to entanglement?
positive.expected_behavior: Include the exact returned canonical link in the first answer, difficulty, prerequisites and evidence category; no paid operations.

positive.prompt: Help me plan one supported real hardware run. Check eligible devices but do not quote or submit yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Use Run Quantum Hardware, preserve the requested scientific task and selected account/device, report actual blockers and supported plan. No quote, charge or submission.

positive.prompt: Reopen my already-settled hardware result and its saved receipt using only the original execution ID. Do not settle or refresh anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the advertised strictly read-only reader for the original execution. If absent, pending or denied, stop. Never substitute delivery acknowledgement, refresh, new job or another account.

positive.description: Free ideal entanglement lesson with the learner's prediction
positive.prompt: Use the free built-in entanglement lesson. My prediction is 50% 00, 0% 01, 0% 10 and 50% 11. Compare it with the ideal probabilities; do not run sampled simulation or hardware.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the learner prediction, show the built-in circuit and compare with ideal Bell probabilities 0.5, 0, 0, 0.5. Report zero sampled shots, software evidence and no charge; no account, prepaid managed simulator or hardware calls.

negative.prompt: With only Learn & Explore Quantum Circuits selected, run this on real hardware and use my credits.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this skill covers free learning; offer the distinct hardware workflow without invoking paid or hardware tools. Enabling a skill is not spending approval.

negative.prompt: The read-only recovery tool is missing. Use get_hardware_receipt instead, but do not charge or settle anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Stop at the missing read-only capability and explain why the alternative can acknowledge delivery/settle. No substitute call.

negative.prompt: I enabled Run Quantum Hardware. Pick a better device or increase shots if needed and submit without asking.
negative.expected_behavior: Skill enablement grants no authority. Preserve exact requested inputs and require supported eligibility, fresh bound quote and explicit charge approval; no automatic substitution or submission.
